employees.title: Manage employees
employees.subtitle: Create accounts, deactivate leavers, and assign supervisors.
employees.cannotDeactivateSelf: You cannot deactivate your own account
employees.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {{name}}? They will no longer be able to log in, but their logged hours are kept.
employees.tracksHoursFor: Compare {{name}}'s logged hours with their work schedule
employees.tracksHoursHint: Switch off for people who don't log their hours, e.g. an owner. They're then left out of the worked vs. expected overview.
employees.resetPasswordHint: They're signed out right away and choose their own password when they next sign in.

account.title: My account
account.successMessage: Password updated. You've been signed out on your other devices.
account.errorMismatch: New password and confirmation don't match.
account.languageHint: Used for the app and for the emails you get.

hourTypes.title: Hour types
hourTypes.subtitle: Define the categories employees can log hours under - Work, Sick Leave, PTO, ADV, or anything else.
hourTypes.name: Name
hourTypes.setAsDefault: Selected by default when logging hours

login.tagline: Log hours. See the whole team. No guesswork at payroll time.
login.sessionEnded: You've been signed out. Sign in again to continue.
login.forgotPasswordAskEmployer: Forgot your password? Ask your employer to reset it.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Extract worked hours by day, week, or month, broken out by type.
reports.emptyState: No hours logged in this period.
reports.balanceHint: Logged hours against each person's work schedule, with the same rules as My hours: up to yesterday (today once it's logged), without public holidays. People who don't track hours aren't listed.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Manage clients and project assignments.
projects.name: Project name
projects.confirmDeactivate: Are you sure you want to archive the project '{{name}}'?

errors.ERR_DATE_LOCKED: You cannot log hours for a locked date.
errors.ERR_UNAUTHORIZED: You do not have permission to view this.

team.title: Team overview
team.subtitle: Everyone whose hours you have authority to view.

tenants.title: Companies
tenants.subtitle: Each company has its own people, hour types, projects and hours, invisible to other companies.
tenants.name: Company name
tenants.firstEmployerHint: Its first employer account. They can add everyone else in the company.
tenants.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {{name}}? Nobody in this company will be able to log in, but all their data is kept.
tenants.resetEmployerPasswordHint: For when an employer is locked out. Give them the temporary password yourself; they're signed out right away and choose their own when they next sign in.
tenants.resetEmployerPasswordDone: Done. Give {{name}} the temporary password; they'll choose their own when they sign in.
tenants.noEmployers: This company has no employer accounts.

platformAdmins.title: Platform admins
platformAdmins.subtitle: Admins manage companies and other admins. They can't see any company's hours or people.
platformAdmins.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {{name}}? They will no longer be able to log in.

emailSettings.title: Email
emailSettings.subtitle: How the app sends email for your company, e.g. notifications about leave requests. Nothing is sent until this is set up and switched on.
emailSettings.providerSmtp: SMTP server (e.g. Brevo, Mailgun, your own mail server)
emailSettings.smtpHint: Leave the username empty if your server doesn't need a login. Microsoft 365 usually blocks password login over SMTP: choose Microsoft 365 instead.
emailSettings.graphHint: Register an app in Microsoft Entra ID with the Mail.Send application permission and admin consent. Restrict it to this mailbox, see the README.
emailSettings.secretKept: Saved, leave empty to keep it
emailSettings.testSent: Test email sent to your address. Check your inbox (and spam folder).

workSchedule.hint: The hours this person normally works. Approved leave is booked with these hours on each working day.
workSchedule.companyHint: The usual working hours in your company. Everyone without their own schedule follows these.
workSchedule.companyNotSet: Not set yet: Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 17:00 with a 30-minute break is used.
workSchedule.sourceCompany: Follows the company schedule. Saving here gives them their own.
workSchedule.sourceBuiltIn: Follows the built-in schedule (Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 17:00), since the company has none. Saving here gives them their own.

leave.title: Leave
leave.subtitle: Request time off and follow up on your requests.
leave.pendingBanner_one: {{count}} leave request is waiting for your approval.
leave.pendingBanner_other: {{count}} leave requests are waiting for your approval.
leave.noLeaveTypes: There are no leave types yet. An employer can mark hour types as leave under Hour types.
leave.previewOverBalance: This is more than your remaining leave. You can still send the request; your approver will see a warning.
leave.overlaps: You already have a pending or approved request in this period.
leave.noWorkingDays: You have no working days in this period.
leave.noRequests: You haven't requested any leave yet.
leave.confirmOverBalance: {{name}} has {{remaining}} of leave left, and this request is {{hours}}. Approve anyway?
leave.rejectReason: Reject the request of {{name}}? You can add a reason (optional).
leave.revokeReason: Revoke the approved leave of {{name}}? The booked hours are removed. You can add a reason (optional).
leave.balancesHint: Set each person's leave allowance for the year in hours. Used hours are hours logged under types that use up the balance.
leave.subtitleEmployer: Review your team's leave requests and manage leave balances.

hoursOverview.title: Worked vs. expected
hoursOverview.hint: Expected hours follow your work schedule ({{hours}} a week): every day up to yesterday, and today once you've logged it. Leave and sick days count as worked.
hoursOverview.teamHint: Difference with each person's schedule, up to yesterday (today once logged)

company.title: Company
company.subtitle: Settings for the whole company: details, usual working hours, public holidays and email.
company.name: Company name
company.regionHint: The country decides which public holidays apply. Only fill in a region where holidays differ per region, e.g. DE-BY for Bavaria.
company.holidaysHint: Nobody is expected to work on these days, and leave over them doesn't use up the balance. Remove days your company works anyway, or add your own days off.
company.setCountryFirst: Set the company's country to load official holidays
company.holidaysUpToDate: All official holidays were already in the list.
company.noHolidays: No holidays for this year yet.
company.confirmDeleteHoliday: Remove {{name}}? People will be expected to work that day.

choosePassword.title: Choose your own password
choosePassword.intro: Welcome, {{name}}. Your current password was set by someone else, so choose your own before you continue.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.intro: Enter your email address and we'll email you a code to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If {{email}} has an account and your company has email set up, a code is on its way. It works for 1 hour.
forgotPassword.noEmail: No email after a few minutes? Check your spam folder, or ask your employer to reset your password.

lockedMonths.title: Closed months
lockedMonths.hint: Lock a month once its hours are final, e.g. after payroll. Nobody can then add, change or delete hours in it, or approve or revoke leave in it, you included. Unlock it to fix something.
lockedMonths.confirmLock: Lock {{month}}? Nobody can change its hours until it is unlocked.
lockedMonths.lockedHint: This month is locked. Ask your employer to unlock it to change this.
lockedMonths.leaveLockedHint: Part of this leave is in a locked month. It can be rejected, but not approved or revoked until the month is unlocked.
lockedMonths.dateLocked: This month is locked: hours in it can no longer be added or changed. Ask your employer if something needs fixing.

activityLog.title: Activity log
activityLog.hint: Who locked or unlocked months, changed someone else's hours, reset a password or (de)activated an account. Entries can't be changed or removed.
